vendors.name: Honest Peptide
vendors.notes: PB rank 8.51 (Strong). WooCommerce; house names GLP-2 TZ = tirzepatide, GLP-3 R = retatrutide. Some items on 20% sale. Narrow size range (mostly one size per product).

vendors.name: Unyx Peptides
vendors.notes: PB rank 8.04 (Strong). Arizona. House names GLP2-T = tirzepatide, GLP3-R = retatrutide. List prices, no sale shown. Broad size ladders.

vendors.name: IDUN Peptides
vendors.notes: Perfect Peptide Critic score per PB. Sells Single Vial / 5-vial / 10-vial options; single-vial prices recorded. Very low prices vs field. House names GLP-2 TZ / GLP-3 RT. Some products (DSIP, Ipamorelin etc.) have no single-vial option for some sizes.

vendors.name: Kylo Peptides
vendors.notes: PB rank 6.35 (Curated: Strong). Sheridan WY. Several items on sale. Premium pricing. Also sells multi-vial 'Stacks' (excluded).

vendors.name: Enhanced Chems
vendors.notes: PB rank 6.36. US-based. Almost every item shows a sale price (strikethrough regular). House codes GLP2 = tirzepatide, GLP-3 RT = retatrutide.

vendors.name: BIOLENO
vendors.notes: PB rank 6.35 (Promising). Wyoming-registered, domain registered Apr 2026. Lowest-price outlier; many blends out of stock. House codes BL-TR2 / BL-RT3 (assumed tirzepatide / retatrutide, not stated on listing).

vendors.name: Artemyx Research
vendors.notes: Delaware-mailed US. Small catalog (~12 SKUs). Everything shown at 20% off sale price.

vendors.name: Prime Lab Peptides
vendors.notes: Miami. Every item shown as sale (~25-50% off strikethrough). Uses non-standard GLP sizes (Retatrutide 6/12/24mg). Also sells 10-vial packs (excluded; single vials recorded).

vendors.name: Alpha Peps
vendors.notes: US-oriented. Product-page prices recorded (store API also carries stale subscription variation prices, ignored). Duplicate listings for some items (e.g. two BPC-157 10mg SKUs at $59 and $43). No GLP-class products listed.

vendors.name: ezPeps
vendors.notes: Michigan. All items on sale (~20-25% off). Sells overfilled vials at odd sizes (11mg, 22mg, 24mg, 33mg, 45mg, 57mg...) so many items don't match standard sizes; recorded at their stated size.
